lists.content:
In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with corporate teams (primarily HR) to understand their problems and ship working internal tools quickly: dashboards, portals, small web apps, reports, and integrations.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc) as your primary means of building, while applying engineering judgement to what those tools produce.

  • Administer, optimize, and expand a multi-tenanted Databricks platform to meet evolving analytics and business intelligence requirements.

  • Teach and coach non-technical stakeholders to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows and tools, which may include running informal group sessions and pairing sessions, or producing guidance, templates, or sufficient guardrails that they can leverage or re-use.

  • Develop and deliver solutions according to lightweight but sensible software development methodologies, with close collaboration MG Core's product engineering arm, to ensure what is built is secure and maintainable.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation, including technical notes, integration docs, and operational and how-to guides written for a non-technical audience.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot the tools you ship, providing timely fixes and keeping stakeholders informed.

  • Keep up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring the best of it back to the team.

  • Gain broad exposure across Match Group’s central services and corporate functions.

• 0-2 years of professional experience as a software engineer, or a recent degree, diploma, or bootcamp qualification in a relevant field.

  • Hands-on experience using agentic development harnesses and similar AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc), with experience or familiarity with agentic instructions (AGENTS.md, skills) and MCP servers.

  • A strong understanding of foundational software principles and programming fundamentals, as well as development lifecycles, spanning source control (GitHub), CI/CD (automated testing and quality analysis), and monitoring (logs, metrics, error detection and troubleshooting).

  • Familiarity with software delivery methodologies, such as agile scrum or kanban.

  • Experience in building modern web frontends (using React or similar), as well as accompanying backend REST APIs.

  • Familiarity with relational/SQL, as well as NoSQL or KV databases.

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare), including conceptual understanding of serverless concepts.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills - a significant part of this role is explaining technical work to non-technical people, so patience, empathy, and clarity matter as much as coding ability.

  • Solid understanding of IT security concepts, as well as sound judgement around data sensitivity and confidentiality - much of what you build will touch employee and business data.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a bias toward delivering value quickly rather than getting it perfect - as is the nature of internal tooling.

  • Strong enthusiasm for software development and eagerness to learn and grow.

  • Legally authorized to work in Canada for the duration of the internship.

• Any exposure to HRIS platforms, especially Workday - even light experience as a user or administrator of a HRIS or similar is valuable here.

  • Experience in the Human Resources domain, or with people data, recruiting, payroll, or benefits systems.

  • Experience working within specific cloud environments, namely Cloudflare (primary) and AWS (secondary).

  • Experience working with serverless hosting technologies, such as Cloudflare Workers.

  • Experience working within containerised environments, such as Docker and/or DevContainers.

  • Exposure or experience working within project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.

  • Experience contributing to open source projects.

  • Experience working at a B2B or SaaS company.

Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
As a key member of our Android team, you will play a vital role in developing and maintaining the Hinge Android mobile application. Your focus will be on implementing new product features, fixing issues, and improving the mobile application user experience. All while leveraging the latest Android tools such as Kotlin, jetpack compose, coroutines, room, hilt and many more. Collaborating within a cross-disciplinary team, including product managers, technical project managers, designers, data engineers, backend engineers, and QA specialists, you will work closely with the Tech Lead and peers to advance our product and contribute to our engineering community. This role offers the opportunity to do high-impact work, directly contributing to a consumer mobile application used by millions. Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer.

You have a point of view on what makes a campaign earn its place in culture, and you're accountable for making sure the work that launches lives up to it.

Know where you belong!
 
Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL in our office 3 days/week.

Role overview:

  • Own the end-to-end content experience for millions of Match users, from help center articles to real-time support during policy changes and product launches

  • Balance strategic ownership (setting the roadmap, voice/tone and editorial standards, defining what success looks like) with hands-on execution (writing, editing, and publishing content)

  • Use data to identify where self-service can replace live support, reducing ticket volume and improving the overall customer experience

  • Example projects: running full content audits across multiple Match Group brands (inventory, quality scoring, gap analysis), designing taxonomies and tag structures that hold up at scale, or building a migration plan for a major policy rollout, deciding what content moves, what gets rewritten, and what retires

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Own the roadmap for help center and support content, with the goal of creating the best end-to-end customer experience and reducing reliance on live support through self-service

  • Analyze help center performance data (traffic, search terms, deflection rate, CSAT) to prioritize the content roadmap and identify new self-service opportunities

  • Write, edit, and publish content for product launches, policy updates, and workflow updates, ensuring accuracy and consistency

  • Define success measures for the program and be accountable for measurable improvements in content discovery, self-serve resolution, and quality

  • Set the standards for how content gets written, categorized, and published, including the style guide, taxonomy, and review process, and conduct regular audits to catch outdated, inaccurate, or inconsistent content before it affects the customer experience

We could be a match if:

  • 4+ years of experience in content strategy, knowledge management, or UX writing, ideally within a support, trust & safety, or operations environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with high attention to detail and a strong editorial eye, comfortable both writing cleanly and editing others' work to the same standard

  • Deep, hands-on fluency with the systems a modern support operation runs on: content management and ticketing platforms (Zendesk or equivalent), and website and product analytics

  • Experience running structured content audits, including how you scored and prioritized content quality

  • Ability to own a domain end to end: define the operating model, set priorities and explicit trade-offs, and drive durable outcomes without formal authority

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business and regulatory challenges into structured, actionable plans

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders across Operations, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Policy

What’s the team like? 

  • This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Customer Experience

  • Help millions of users get accurate answers on their own terms, reducing friction and building trust in every product we support, so live support is reserved for what genuinely needs a person

  • You'll work in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with Product, Ops, Legal, and Policy to keep content ahead of launches and policy changes

  • Success looks like measurable progress toward an industry-standard customer experience, reflected in higher customer satisfaction and retention, and driven day-to-day by improvements in self-serve resolution, ticket deflection, and content quality

descriptionPlain:
Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


The Team or Role: 
Match Group’s Analytics Team is looking for a Data Scientist II with expertise in Marketing Analytics.
Our analytics team serves the entire MG portfolio, acting as a center of excellence to standardize how we measure marketing performance across all our global brands, including industry leading names like Tinder and Hinge. We develop a deep understanding of the business and its data and establish close working relationships with all teams including Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Finance, so that we can provide recommendations and make proposals regarding prioritization of initiatives, marketing investments, A/B tests, and company performance.
 
As a data scientist in this role, you will partner with Marketing teams at each of our BUs, providing support through advanced marketing measurement techniques, A/B test design and analysis, and data-driven insights through ad-hoc analyses, presentations, and automated reports and dashboards. This role will require extensive experience with SQL, data wrangling, statistics, econometric modeling, and A/B testing, as well as the ability to work in cross-functional teams to drive actionable insights. Experience with user growth and acquisition across multi-brand consumer products is a plus.
 
Where you’ll work:
This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three days per week. This position is located in NYC or Los Angeles.

• Master and be responsible for analyzing marketing and business performance.

  • Build models better to understand the impact of our marketing investments and strategy

  • Find the “story” in the data and communicate insights and opportunities with executives and other internal teams.

  • Perform ongoing ad-hoc analyses to evaluate the efficiency of our marketing spend, build reporting infrastructure, and assist in making budgeting recommendations to optimize growth.

  • Integrate captured event data with other customer data sources, such as surveys, ad publishers, and app store data.

  • Support reporting and business intelligence needs of the entire Marketing team.

• 3+ years of relevant experience in analytics or data science

  • Experience building bayesian regressions and/or other marketing measurement techniques

  • Experience designing, executing, and measuring geo experiments and causal inference techniques

  • Ability to think objectively and interpret meaningful themes from quantitative and qualitative data

  • Ability to build constructive and effective relationships with a broad and diverse group of business partners

  • Ability to execute complex analytics projects where you have to determine salient questions in a complex ecosystem and present action-oriented conclusions

  • Proficiency with SQL required

  • Scripting skills, preferably in Python. 

  • Knowledge of statistics, specifically experimental design and analysis

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint (or equivalents)

  • Familiarity with common marketing KPIs, metrics, and growth experiments

• Curiosity about how things work, from both a business and technical perspective, leading to the identification and exploration of new strategic opportunities, potential improvements to our data infrastructure, and deepening our understanding of member behavior.

  • Proactive collaborator skilled in engaging with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Machine Learning) to influence decision-making, confidently voicing concerns and alternative perspectives

  • Ability to prioritize time across multiple projects and communicate timelines

descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
Most consumer apps treat your attention as the product, optimizing every recommendation and notification to keep you scrolling. Hinge made the opposite bet: our mission is to get people off the app, out on a date, and eventually to delete us entirely. That is not a tagline. It is the actual constraint every AI system we build has to solve against.
 

The Director of AI, Dating Outcomes owns the hardest version of that problem. You will lead the AI systems at the core of how Hinge connects people: the recommendation engine, the ranking models, and the generative capabilities that help users put their best selves forward. The goal is not engagement, it is outcomes: fewer ratings per exchange, higher quality matches, and more people finding the person they were looking for. Because Hinge does not sell ads or user data, being exceptional at this is our business model. Reporting to the VP of AI, you will set the long-term AI roadmap for one of the company's most influential product areas and build the teams that bring it to life. The problems sit at the intersection of human behavior, sparse real-world signals, and a two-sided ecosystem of people who are not interchangeable, a different kind of ML challenge than most people in this industry have had the chance to work on.

• Strategy and Vision: Own the AI strategy for dating recommendations across the full journey, from first candidate to last date. Build the frameworks to reason rigorously through ecosystem tradeoffs where a win for one cohort reshapes another, and set a vision ambitious enough that the org wants to chase it.

  • Cross-Functional and Industry Leadership: Partner closely with other product groups to integrate AI capabilities across the product and shape roadmap decisions you do not own. Communicate honestly with executive leadership on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress. Own budget and investment strategy for the area, and represent Hinge externally through writing, talks, and community.

  • Technical Leadership: Steer real-time, personalized recommendation systems that reduce ratings per exchange and drive better matches. Bring Generative AI to dating outcomes in ways that are differentiated, authentic, and grounded in how people actually connect.

  • Responsible AI: Hold the bar on scalability, resilience, and rigorous evaluation for both performance and bias. 

  • Team and Organizational Development: Structure and scale the team for both deep execution and long-horizon bets. Develop emerging leaders, invest in succession across IC and leadership tracks, and build a culture where rigor, inclusion, and performance reinforce one another.

  • Execution Excellence: Drive predictable delivery, balancing urgent risk response with long-term platform investments. Establish scalable operating rhythms for planning, technical reviews, and incident learnings.

• 10 or more years across data science, applied ML, and software engineering, with 6 or more years in AI or engineering leadership defining strategy, not just managing execution.

  • A track record of leading real-time, personalized recommendation systems in production, including the relevance, fairness, and scale tradeoffs that carry real consequences.

  • Demonstrated success scaling ML or AI teams and developing technical leaders who carry the work over years, not a single launch.

  • Deep technical fluency across ML, RL, Generative AI, and MLOps, with the communication skills and executive presence to represent AI strategy at the highest levels of the organization.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. A PhD is a plus, not a requirement.

    •  

    What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience building AI systems in a two-sided or constrained marketplace, where optimizing for one group shifts outcomes for another and the right answer is rarely obvious.

  • A history of deploying Generative AI thoughtfully in user-facing experiences, not as a trend to follow.

  • External presence through publishing, speaking, or community contribution that reflects genuine intellectual engagement with the field.

  • Prior work in a domain where user outcomes are high-stakes and hard to measure, whether health, education, finance, or something comparably consequential.

About the Role
 
Most consumer apps treat your attention as the product, optimizing every recommendation and notification to keep you scrolling. Hinge made the opposite bet: our mission is to get people off the app, out on a date, and eventually to delete us entirely. That is not a tagline. It is the actual constraint every AI system we build has to solve against.
 

The Director of AI, Dating Outcomes owns the hardest version of that problem. You will lead the AI systems at the core of how Hinge connects people: the recommendation engine, the ranking models, and the generative capabilities that help users put their best selves forward. The goal is not engagement, it is outcomes: fewer ratings per exchange, higher quality matches, and more people finding the person they were looking for. Because Hinge does not sell ads or user data, being exceptional at this is our business model. Reporting to the VP of AI, you will set the long-term AI roadmap for one of the company's most influential product areas and build the teams that bring it to life. The problems sit at the intersection of human behavior, sparse real-world signals, and a two-sided ecosystem of people who are not interchangeable, a different kind of ML challenge than most people in this industry have had the chance to work on.
